newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kwoon Chung looks to benefit from new HK airport.
newsitem.headline: Kwoon Chung looks to benefit from new HK airport.

text.p: Kwoon Chung Bus Holdings Ltd looks set to benefit from Hong Kong's new airport after a report released on Monday proposed that bus service on Lantau island should be part of the airport's transport links.
Bus services on Lantau, an outlying island where Chek Lap Kok airport is located, is operated by the New Lantau Bus Co, which is wholly owned by Kwoon Chung.

The study, commissioned by Hong Kong's colonial government, also recommended that railways, high-speed ferries, taxis and minibuses serve the new airport, which is to begin operation in April 1998, a transport department official said in a statement.
